info.name: Slate API
info.description: Contract tests mirroring docs/04, covering the M1 surface end to end: auth, jobs CRUD + publish, the public careers + apply flow (SAS/local CV upload), applications list/detail, and stage moves. Runs against a freshly seeded database (no jobs), creating its own data and chaining ids through collection variables.
